chain.title: Ars Ecclesia
chain.desc: Keep the Ars Ecclesia codex close while exploring Eidolon's rituals and chants. Learn the signs and offering requirements from its entries; owning an altar alone does not teach every chant.

chain.title: Silver From the Overworld
chain.desc: Silver Ore generates worldwide via a biome modifier. Half of Pewter, and the metal the Bone Paladin's armour needs.

chain.title: The Heavier Half
chain.desc: Lead Ore, or the drop from a Zombie Brute. Alloyed with silver it becomes the mod's working metal.

chain.title: Bones, Burned
chain.desc: Smelt a bone. Sprinkled on the floor it draws the working circles, and it is the base of Parchment and Sulfur.

chain.title: Rendered Fat
chain.desc: Blasted from raw meat, and the wax under every candle the altars need.

chain.title: A Figure Made of Straw
chain.desc: Hay and sticks. Chanting at an Effigy is how the mod first hears you at all.

chain.title: The Wooden Altar
chain.desc: Build a Wooden Altar and arrange supported decorations around it. Consult the codex for how power and devotion differ before starting offerings and chants.

chain.title: Cut From a Brute
chain.desc: Zombie Brutes drop it, and Eidolon's LivingDropsEvent puts it on ordinary zombies too. It renders down into Essence of Death.

chain.title: Something Cold Over the Water
chain.desc: Wraiths spawn in the dark Overworld by biome modifier and hover over any fluid. Only they drop Tattered Cloth and Wraith Hearts.

chain.title: The Last Wave
chain.desc: Necromancers appear in the final waves of a village raid and are the only source of the Summoning Staff.

chain.title: What Sleeps in the Catacombs
chain.desc: Explore the Catacombs and defeat a Giant Skeleton for its Imbued Bone drops. The locating ritual can help with the search, but the encounter remains a separate expedition branch.

chain.title: Pewter
chain.desc: Alloy the required silver and lead into Pewter. Split the first supply between a Crucible and worktable components so alchemy and equipment crafting can grow in parallel.

chain.title: Light for the Altar
chain.desc: Prepare suitable altar candles and inspect the altar's resulting power. Lighting is one part of the arrangement; compare the codex's other altar decorations before making more candles.

chain.title: For the Blood
chain.desc: Use the Goblet in the altar offering process described by the codex. It is one route for developing devotion; incense work with the Censer offers a different branch.

chain.title: Grave Wrappings
chain.desc: A Wraith's leavings, and the cloth of the Reaper's Scythe, the Raven Cloak and the Bone Paladin's helm.

chain.title: An Inlay of Base Metal
chain.desc: Pewter beaten flat around a stone. It is the Magic Workbench's frame and the blank an Unholy Symbol is chanted from.

chain.title: Set the Crucible Boiling
chain.desc: Place the Crucible above the required heat source and follow the recipe's ingredient and stirring steps in order. Start with a simple recipe before attempting expensive alchemy.

chain.title: For the Smoke
chain.desc: Prepare an incense recipe and burn it in the Censer as the codex describes. Monitor the outcome before spending a large supply on repeated offerings.

chain.title: Vestige of the Bone Paladin
chain.desc: Combine the Catacomb and Wraith materials with the required holy-path components at the worktable. This equipment project should follow the path described in the codex, not force unrelated dark-path upgrades.

chain.title: The Magic Workbench
chain.desc: Use the worktable's main pattern and additional reagent slots together. Check every slot against the codex recipe before assuming an ordinary crafting-table arrangement will work.

chain.title: Devotion, Earned
chain.desc: Develop the required devotion and perform the appropriate chant to create the Unholy Symbol. Check the codex's progression entries when a chant is not yet available.

chain.title: Essence of Death
chain.desc: Process one of the supported heart ingredients in the Crucible to obtain Essence of Death. Use the listed alternatives rather than assuming only a Zombie Heart can supply this recipe.

chain.title: Splinters of the Dead
chain.desc: Use the unlocked soul-harvesting methods to collect Soul Shards. These become a shared supply for Crucible alchemy, advanced equipment and soul-based enchanting.

chain.title: The Ritual Knife
chain.desc: Pewter, an Inlay and an ender pearl at the Workbench. It forages Avennian Sprigs and Merammer Root out of ordinary flowers.

chain.title: Light the Brazier
chain.desc: The ritual apparatus proper. Surround it with Plinths holding the pedestal items, drop in the reagent, and it summons, crafts or locates.

chain.title: Write the Chants Down
chain.desc: Use the Scriptorium to prepare a Chant Scroll for a sign sequence you have learned. Confirm how the scroll is used before relying on it away from the altar.

chain.title: Gold, Made Arcane
chain.desc: Follow the Arcane Gold Crucible recipe in its stated order, including any stirring stages. Reserve the result for advanced inlays and the soul-enchanting workshop.

chain.title: The Altar in Stone
chain.desc: Upgrade your altar using the worktable recipe and reassemble its decorations. Confirm the new arrangement's power before attempting a more demanding chant.

chain.title: A Stone of Solid Dark
chain.desc: Essence of Death and Soul Shards in the Crucible. The gem behind the Soulfire Wand, the Soulbone Amulet and Archangel's Sight.

chain.title: A Soul, Contained
chain.desc: Soul Shards fused in the Crucible. It powers the wands, the Reversal Pick and the Gravity Belt.

chain.title: The Reaper's Scythe
chain.desc: Use the worktable to assemble the Reaper's Scythe from the required soul and Wraith materials. Test its harvesting behaviour against a familiar target before planning a larger soul farm.

chain.title: The Elder Statue
chain.desc: A Gold Inlay and your patron symbol. With the Stone Altar it opens villager sacrifice and the deeper half of the Dark path.

chain.title: Enchanting With Souls
chain.desc: Build the Soul Enchanter and provide Soul Shards for its enchanting process. This gives your soul-harvesting branch a practical use beyond crafting more weapons.

chain.title: Archangel's Sight
chain.desc: Complete Archangel's Sight with the required alchemical materials and symbol. Inspect its effect after equipping it so the late accessory serves a clear purpose in your build.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Parallel metal/alchemy and altar/devotion paths, soul equipment and separate creature expeditions.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
